_claim_tolerance_note: Widened from the stand-in's 0.01 because the re-base moved the evaluation split behind the verifier, which makes an exact self-measurement impossible and made a 0.01 band a trap rather than a test. A solver holding out its own slice of the agent-visible corpus can estimate within 0.02, and 0.02 is still tighter than the superseded 0.05, so the stale control ctl-divergence-verdict-under-loose-tolerance keeps its direction: its planted discrepancy of 0.03 passes at 0.05 and fails here.
_compute_budget_note: Optimizer STEPS of 524288 tokens each, one forward and one backward per step, not tokens consumed. 3250 is the substrate's baseline_steps_to_target, record 36. The checker field name is unchanged so the declared grading surface survives the re-base; the unit it counts is redefined in environment/frozen/optimizer_config.json.
_denominator_note: The byte length of the verifier's held-out FineWeb slice, pinned by environment/frozen/data_config.json validation.held_out_slice_bytes. The slice is absent from environment/ and from the agent image, so the solver cannot measure this quotient and can only estimate it.
_max_vocab_note: The frozen embedding width from the substrate, superseding the stand-in's 8192 table ceiling. A vocabulary above it cannot be embedded by the frozen architecture at all.
_sustain_band_note: Measured, and no longer provisional. See sustain_band_authority.
